device_entry.name: RIC温度控制器
tags: 环境控制与稳定性测试
device_entry.description: 用于实验中温度设定、温度读取与设备状态查询的温控仪器。该接口还支持空闲模式、版本查询、调试输出以及发送原始命令，适合将温度控制集成到自动化实验流程中。
device_entry.description_en: A temperature-control instrument used in laboratory workflows for setting temperature, reading back temperature, and checking device status. The interface also supports idle mode, version queries, debug output, and raw command execution for integration into automated experiments.
